title: Eight Sleep life scenes
description: A light-grey band of everyday scenes: a centered heading with a sub-line and link, then three big rounded photos set in a zig-zag (tall, small, wide), each with a dark frosted widget card overlapping its edge (a mono label, a big condensed figure or a row of chips, a short caption). On desktop the widgets fade in and float upward faster than the page (180px → -180px), so they hover over the photos as you scroll.
notes: reconstructed from the media sizes and motion list: the original's capture hid this section behind a popup
three media slots: 621×720, 388×450, 720×726 on desktop (350×406/406/420 on phones), radius 20px
CSS only: a named view timeline per scene drives its widget; reduced motion holds them still
